Return APPLY with one concrete, minimal workflow change. Preserve triggers, permissions, jobs, matrix, runners, environment, dependencies, shell commands, required checks and all original steps. For caching, add a narrow trusted actions/cache@v4 step or configure caching on an existing setup action. Key it by runner OS and the best available checked-in dependency inputs (lockfiles when present; otherwise dependency manifests, Makefile/install declarations and workflow setup). Cache only dependency download state, use exact keys without broad restore fallbacks, and always run every original install and test command on cache hits. Do not skip work based on cache-hit outputs. For timeout patterns change only job timeout-minutes, using baseline evidence with headroom. Do not add networking/deploy/publish/secret usage or replace action versions. The baseline already passed the required checks. Keep the change narrow so those same commands still run and can pass; the measured CI runs determine whether the candidate succeeds and whether it helps. If the method has a limitation, record it in rationale but still implement the closest valid version of the selected method. Return ONLY JSON: {pattern_id, decision: APPLY, rationale, workflow_yaml}. workflow_yaml must contain the complete changed file.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron:  '0 0 * * 1'

jobs:
  formatting:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Check out code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: 3.14
      - name: Setup
        run: ./ci/setup.sh
      - name: Check formatting
        run: ./ci/format.sh
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]
    steps:
      - name: Check out code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Python ${{matrix.python-version}}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: ${{matrix.python-version}}
      - name: Setup
        run: ./ci/setup.sh
      - name: Create local settings
        run: cat cppquiz/local_settings_example.py | sed 's_/path/to/your/code/cppquiz_'"$PWD"'_'> cppquiz/local_settings.py
      - name: Test
        run: pytest --verbose
  required-checks:
    name: Required checks
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    needs:
      - test
      - formatting
    steps:
      - run: |
          if [[ "${{ needs.test.result }}" != "success" ]]; then
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "${{ needs.formatting.result }}" != "success" ]]; then
            exit 1
          fi
          exit 0
